name: todo-scan
description: Find TODO/FIXME markers in the workspace. A worked example of the plugin contract.
author: Adaptive Agent Harness

tools.name: scan_markers
tools.description: List TODO, FIXME, XXX and HACK comments under a directory, with file and line.

path.description: Directory to scan. Defaults to the workspace root.

limit.description: Maximum markers to report. Defaults to 50.
